title: Level-one Fourier weight bound
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $0$ and $1$, and let its mean be $\alpha$. For every real number $\rho$ with $0<\rho\le 1$, the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all singleton coordinate sets is at most $\rho^{-1}\left(\alpha^{2/(1+\rho)}-\alpha^2\right)$.
